description: This Java class 'FlagManager' provides functionality to retrieve flag icons for regions and languages, mainly for locale display purposes within the Android Studio environment. It manages a cache of flag icons, supports various input formats (language/region codes, folder names), and provides cell renderers for UI components.

classes.name: FlagManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing locale flag icons, providing methods to retrieve flags based on language and region codes, folder names, and qualifiers, along with UI cell renderers.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of FlagManager.

methods.name: getFlag
methods.description: Retrieves a flag icon based on language and region strings.

methods.name: getFlag
methods.description: Retrieves a flag icon based on LanguageQualifier and RegionQualifier objects.

methods.name: getFlagForFolderName
methods.description: Gets a flag icon based on a resource folder name indicating locale.

methods.name: getFlag
methods.description: Retrieves a flag icon for a specific region code.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Internal method to load and cache the icon for a given region code.

methods.name: getLanguageCodeCellRenderer
methods.description: Provides a ListCellRenderer for displaying language codes with flags.

methods.name: getRegionCodeCellRenderer
methods.description: Provides a ListCellRenderer for displaying region codes with flags.

methods.name: getLanguageNameMapper
methods.description: Returns a function mapping language codes to 'code: name' strings.

methods.name: getRegionNameMapper
methods.description: Returns a function mapping region codes to 'code: name' strings.
